Lemma
[General Hölder inequality] ↗ lem:holders-inequality 1. appB:B.2-g\group Elementary Inequalities

Let $1\leq p_1,\ldots ,p_m\leq \infty $ satisfy \[ \sum _{k=1}^m\frac1{p_k}=1, \] and suppose $u_k\in L^{p_k}(U)$ for $k=1,\ldots ,m$. Then \[ (11)\qquad \int _U|u_1\cdots u_m|\, dx \leq \prod _{k=1}^m\| u_k\| _{L^{p_k}(U)}. \]
Proof

\sketch Induct on $m$, applying section 2 at each step with the conjugate exponents determined by the remaining reciprocal sum.

□
